why: Outdoor Life measured the output of panels up to 400W and names a best 400W pick, so one major reviewer answers the question with testing. OutdoorGearLab tests panels too, but its pick is 200W, so it only answers in part. The rest are a deal post, affiliate listicles, a few pages that returned no text, and Amphourly, a niche data site. No source works out whether 400W is enough for a 2 kWh station over several days, so a focused sizing-and-pick page could still get in, but it would compete with Outdoor Life.
